live.headline: NOCTURNAL SPIDER: a named actor with little public detail on file
live.in_short: NOCTURNAL SPIDER appears in a threat-actor catalogue, but the record gives no aliases or tools. None of the source cards we reviewed mention it, so no behaviour, targets or operations can be described.

sentences.t: NOCTURNAL SPIDER is the name of a threat actor entry in the MISP galaxy catalogue.
The catalogue record lists no aliases for the actor.
The catalogue record also lists no tools used by the actor.
Treat this entry as a name only. Look for primary vendor or government reporting before drawing any conclusions about this actor.
